race.comment: SWEET ISSY (2) looks the horse to beat after turning a narrow Bunbury second into a determined win there, scoring from Royal Reflection with Watson staying aboard. The form out of that race has been sound and that was her first try at the mile. Can build on that effort to repeat the dose. SUNDAY MASS (4) resumes off two trials and looks a progressive type, having won a Mdn at Pinjarra before tackling the G3 WA Oaks at this venue. Drawn the inside and she can resume on a positive note with Nottle sticking from the trials. DYNASTIC LASS (9) was a clear Bunbury Mdn winner as favourite and returns quickly. The way she finished off there suggests the rise in trip is no issue and she can go on with the job. FORGOT THE ROCK (3) also arrives off a Northam Mdn win, was held up before scoring, and has already won at this distance, which keeps him in the winning mix if he backs up that late improvement. GINGER AND TONIC (11) won't be far away on her latest effort.
